# CoreUI Scheduler Vue.js documentation

> Vue resource and time scheduler for CoreUI — day, week, month, agenda, resource and timeline views with drag & drop, RFC 5545 recurrence and full keyboard support.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/scheduler/vue/docs/getting-started/introduction.md): Vue resource and time scheduler — day, week, month, agenda, resource and timeline views with drag & drop, RFC 5545 recurrence, DST-safe time handling and full keyboard support.
- [Installation](/scheduler/vue/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install CoreUI Scheduler for Vue with npm and load its stylesheet.
- [Quickstart](/scheduler/vue/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): Render your first scheduler: the CScheduler component and an events array.

## Views

- [Day & week](/scheduler/vue/docs/views/day-week.md): The time-grid views: hours on the vertical axis, one column per day, with a configurable visible-hours window.
- [Month](/scheduler/vue/docs/views/month.md): A full-month grid with per-day event chips, overflow links, and drag by day.
- [Agenda](/scheduler/vue/docs/views/agenda.md): A chronological list of upcoming events grouped by day.
- [Resources](/scheduler/vue/docs/views/resources.md): One column per room, person or machine — with automatic column virtualization past a dozen resources.
- [Timeline](/scheduler/vue/docs/views/timeline.md): A horizontal resource timeline: one row per resource, bars across a continuous multi-day axis, overlaps stacked into lanes.

## Features

- [Drag and drop](/scheduler/vue/docs/features/drag-and-drop.md): Move and resize events with the pointer — snapped to a configurable step, previewed live, cancellable with Escape.
- [Remote data](/scheduler/vue/docs/features/remote-data.md): Load events on demand as users navigate, and persist every change back to your server.
- [Creating events](/scheduler/vue/docs/features/creating-events.md): Create events by dragging across empty slots — or entirely from the keyboard.
- [Recurrence](/scheduler/vue/docs/features/recurrence.md): RFC 5545 RRULE recurrence with windowed, DST-safe expansion, exception dates, and per-occurrence editing.
- [Business hours & now](/scheduler/vue/docs/features/business-hours.md): Shade non-working hours and days, and mark the current time in today's column.
- [Overlap control](/scheduler/vue/docs/features/overlap.md): Reject drops, resizes and creations that would collide with another event.
- [Keyboard & accessibility](/scheduler/vue/docs/features/keyboard-accessibility.md): Every pointer operation has a keyboard equivalent, and every operation is announced — WCAG 2.2 dragging movements, built in.

## Customization

- [Styling & theming](/scheduler/vue/docs/customization/styling.md): Every visual knob is a --cui-scheduler-* CSS variable resolving through CoreUI semantic tokens.
- [Localization](/scheduler/vue/docs/customization/localization.md): Localize every label and announcement, and let Intl format the dates.

## API

- [Options & events](/scheduler/vue/docs/api/options.md): The full CScheduler props, emitted events, and the template-ref API.
- [Event model](/scheduler/vue/docs/api/event-model.md): The SchedulerEvent shape: ISO dates, all-day flags, colors, and RFC 5545 recurrence.
